name: demo_create_ticket
description: Create a new ticket in the demo ticket management system (placeholder for ServiceNow or similar). Use when escalating an exception that needs human approval, assigning work to a team member, or logging an issue for tracking. Returns the created ticket with its ID.

description.description: Detailed description of the issue or request

priority.description: Ticket priority — values from tickets.schema.json TicketPriority (default: medium)

assigned_to.description: Person or team to assign the ticket to

case_id.description: Related ERP case ID for correlation (e.g. PO number)

response_type.description: Expected response type: 'approval' for approve/deny workflow, 'free_text' when you need a written answer from the reviewer (default: approval)

proposed_write.description: The SAP write you are asking permission to make. Supply it whenever the ticket asks for approval of a write; omit it when you are only asking a question. The console renders it as a before/after diff instead of prose, and verifies your 'current' values against what this run actually read.

entity.description: Entity set for update/create, or the function name for function_import

key.description: Key values of the record, slash-joined, e.g. 5105600000/2026

fields.description: One entry per field the write changes. A function_import lists its parameters.

current.description: The value in SAP today. Only include it if you read this value in this run — omit it rather than guessing.

proposed.description: The value you intend to write

name: demo_get_ticket
description: Get a single ticket by ID from the demo ticket management system.
